description:
Noema is an open lab for every STEM field, with one rule: show your work. This app is its notebook. Every result the lab has logged is here, from Busy Beaver machines and Collatz residues to exoplanet orbits and clinical trial tables, each with how it was checked.

Every finding carries its claim level, never blurred: observed, written proof, machine-checked in Lean, or reproduced from the literature. A finite check never becomes a universal claim, and the app says which is which.

Open a finding to read the full claim, the second check that backs it, what the literature search found, and where it stands. Sequences, trials and papers it names are listed with a copy button and a link to OEIS, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed or the DOI.

Reported follows the results the lab sent outside: OEIS edits read in review or accepted, and ClinicalTrials.gov cells read still wrong or fixed, checked live against the public sites each time you open the app or press Command-R.

Browse by field, see only what is proved or only the candidates, or search across every claim, sequence and trial number. The list updates from the lab's public ledger, so new findings arrive without an update.

No account, no tracking, nothing stored. Light and dark.
promotionalText: Every finding from an open STEM lab, with its claim level, its second check and its sources.
whatsNew: Every finding the lab has logged, not just the reported ones: 133 results across eleven fields, each with how it was checked and the sequences, trials and papers it names, ready to copy. Search, Proved and Candidates views, and light mode.
